title: Question 1.2: Reading CSV File
instruction: This code reads data from a file. Think about what happens when you open a spreadsheet file - the program needs to know how to interpret the file format.
reveal: This code reads the CSV file into a Dataset (a structured collection of data). The `.option("header", "true")` tells Spark that the first row contains column names. The `.option("inferSchema", "false")` means "don't guess the data types - use the schema we defined instead." The `.schema(schema)` applies the schema we created earlier, and `.csv(CSV_FILE)` specifies which file to read.

questions.title: Question 1.2a: What do you think this code is doing?
questions.description:
Look at this code snippet:

Dataset<Row> data = spark.read()
    .option("header", "true")
    .option("inferSchema", "false")
    .schema(schema)
    .csv(CSV_FILE);

What do you think this code is doing?
